app.backupNudge: Your plan is kept only in this browser. Save a backup file now and then so you can't lose it.
app.name: Plot planner
app.noPlotHelp: Add a plot to start planning: give it a name and its size, and draw your beds.
app.storageUnavailable: This browser won't let the app save, so changes will be lost when you close the page. Private browsing often causes this.
app.undoHint: Undo the last change (Ctrl or Cmd + Z)
crop.importError: That isn't a crop file. It needs an id, names, a category and timing rules.
crop.intro: {n} crops, with sowing, planting and harvest times worked out from your frost dates. Choose one to see its details and your dates. Edit anything: your changes are kept even when the library updates.
crop.introLicence: The library is open data (CC0). Anyone can add or correct a crop through a pull request.
crop.name: Name
crop.sourceHint: For example, a book, seed packet or your own records
crop.timingHelp: Each rule is a window of days before (negative) or after (positive) a local event. Example: -56 to -42 days from last frost is 8 to 6 weeks before it.
crop.varietyInUse: That variety is used by a planting or seed packet, so it stays.
entry.problemHelp: Problems logged in a bed show as warnings when a crop prone to them is planned there.
help.backup.body: Your plan is stored in this browser only. Save a backup file now and then from Settings, and keep it somewhere safe. To use another device, restore the backup file there.
help.backup.title: Backing up and moving devices
help.drafts.body: Mark a planting as a draft to try an idea without changing your plan. Plans that other people share with you also arrive as drafts. Accept a draft to make it part of the plan, or discard it.
help.drafts.title: Drafts
help.intro: Draw your plot, add what you plan to grow, and the planner works out when to sow, plant out and harvest, month by month. Everything stays on this device.
help.month.body:
Each month shows your plot coloured by what is growing, with that month's jobs beside it. A green outline marks beds where something changes that month. Drafts have a dashed outline and say "draft".
Use the arrow keys to step through months, or All months to see the whole season at a glance. Select a bed to see what is there now, what comes next and what grew there before.
help.month.title: The month view
help.more: More detail is in the full guide:
help.offline.body: Once you have opened the planner, it works without a signal. Add it to your home screen from your browser's menu to open it like an app.
help.offline.title: Using it at the plot
help.plantings.body:
A planting is a variety, in a place, over a date range. When you add one, the dates are worked out from the crop and your frost dates. Change any of them and they stay as you set them.
Warnings tell you when a bed is too full, crops overlap, the same family comes back too soon, or a crop won't fit your season.
help.plantings.title: Plantings
help.privacy.body: There are no accounts, no tracking and no adverts. Nothing you enter leaves this device unless you save a file and share it yourself.
help.privacy.title: Privacy
help.seeds.body: Keep track of seed packets, sets, tubers and plants. Already have a list in a spreadsheet? Import it: match up the columns, check the suggestions, and add.
help.seeds.title: Seeds
help.start.body:
You start with an example plot. Have a look round, then make your own: in Settings, set your frost dates and add a plot with its size and which way is up.
In Layout, add beds and draw them to scale by dragging, or type the numbers. Split a bed into sections, or a section into rows for interplanting.
help.start.title: Getting started
help.tasks.body:
Sowing, potting on, hardening off, planting out, harvesting and clearing are listed for you from your plantings. Add your own jobs too, including yearly ones like pruning.
Tick a job off and the planting moves along. Add to calendar saves a file your phone or computer calendar can import, so you get reminders without an account.
help.tasks.title: Tasks and reminders
help.title: How to use the plot planner
imp.error.read: That file couldn't be read. Save it as CSV or .xlsx and try again.
imp.intro: Use the list you already keep: a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file with one packet per row. You'll match its columns, check suggestions, and nothing is added until you say so.
imp.issue.badDate: "{text}" couldn't be read as a date and is left blank.
imp.issue.dateText: "{text}" isn't a date, so it's recorded as how you got it: {source}.
imp.issue.duplicate: Looks like a duplicate of another packet with the same variety, supplier and date. Left out unless you tick it.
imp.issue.family: The sheet says {given}, but {crop} is in {family}. The library's family will be used.
imp.issue.newVariety: {name} will be added as a new variety of {crop}.
imp.issue.unmatched: "{text}" isn't in the crop library. Choose the crop it is, or leave the row out.
imp.mapHelp: Say what each column holds. Columns set to "Leave out" are ignored.
imp.needCrop: Pick the column with the crop or variety name to carry on.
imp.privacy: The file is read in your browser and never uploaded.
imp.reviewHelp: Check each row. Pick a crop for any the app couldn't match, untick rows you don't want, then add them.
imp.title: Import seeds from a spreadsheet
journal.empty.all: Nothing in the journal yet. Note what you see, log harvests, and record pests and diseases: they help next year's plan.
journal.empty.harvest: No harvests logged yet. Log one from here or from a bed on the month view.
journal.empty.problem: No problems noted. Long may it last.
language.name: English
layout.canvas: Layout of {name}. Select a bed or feature, then drag it, drag its handles, or use the arrow keys.
layout.fromHelp: Leave blank if it is always there. Beds you build later only show from that month.
layout.help: Drag to move. Drag a handle to resize. Arrow keys nudge, Shift moves further.
layout.label: Label
layout.name: Name
layout.perennial: Long-term planting (fruit, asparagus, herbs). Left out of rotation.
layout.plotEndHelp: For a tenancy that ends. Plantings that run past it get a warning.
layout.selectHint: Select a bed or feature on the plan to change it.
layout.sideHelp: The side of the plot this fence or wall is on, for shade.
lot.parentHelp: Link saved seed to the planting it came from to follow a line back over the years.
month.hint: Select an area on the plan to see what is there now, what comes next and what grew there before.
month.noElsewhereJobs: Nothing at home or in the propagator.
month.noPlotJobs: Nothing to do on the plot this month.
pe.agreementHelp: Drafts show dashed on the plan and only join it when you accept them.
pe.datesAuto: Worked out from your frost dates. Change any date and it stays as you set it.
pe.datesEdited: You have set these dates. Work them out again to go back to the defaults.
pe.fitsNot: {area} fits {fits} {unit} ({working}), but you have {needed}. Plant fewer, space them closer, or choose a bigger area.
pe.followsHelp: If the crop before runs late, this planting moves back with it.
pe.interplanted: Interplanted with what else is here
pl.draftsHelp: Drafts sit beside your agreed plan without changing it. Accept the ones you want to keep.
pl.noDrafts: No drafts. Plans shared with you, and plantings you mark as draft, show here.
plan.aria: Plan of {name}, {w} by {l} metres, {top} at the top
prop.empty: No propagation spaces yet. Add your windowsill, propagator or shelves to see how full they get week by week.
prop.intro: Where seedlings are raised: windowsills, heated propagators, greenhouse benches, grow-light shelves. Each module-sown planting takes room from sowing until it is planted out, including any wait while its bed is cleared.
prop.overWarn: Over capacity in {n} weeks, from the week of {week}, with up to {peak} needed in room for {capacity}. Move a sowing later, use another space, or sow fewer.
prop.reserveHelp: Block room for something that isn't a planting, such as drying beans or curing squash.
seeds.empty: No seed recorded yet. Add packets one at a time, or import the list you already keep in a spreadsheet.
settings.aboutText: Plot planner is free, open-source software for planning a food-growing space. It works offline and needs no account.
settings.dataIntro: Everything is kept in this browser on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere. Save a backup file now and then, and to move your plan to another device.
settings.deleteGardenHelp: This deletes the garden with all its plots, plantings and tasks. You can undo straight after.
settings.deletePlotHelp: This deletes its layout, plantings and tasks. You can undo straight after, or restore from a backup.
settings.eraseHelp: This removes all your plots, plantings, tasks and seeds from this browser. Back up first if you might want them.
settings.frostApply: Change frost dates and move plan
settings.frostApplyHelp: Changing these moves every planned date to keep its place relative to your frosts.
settings.frostHelp: Ask at your allotment site or a local garden centre; experienced neighbours usually know. National weather services and seed companies publish frost-date maps and postcode tools. If unsure, pick a date a week or two later for the last frost and earlier for the first: it's safer.
settings.frostHelpTitle: How do I find my frost dates?
settings.frostIntro: Every sowing and planting date is worked out from your average last frost in spring and first frost in autumn.
settings.latHelp: Used for day length, which slows growth in winter. Rough is fine: whole degrees are enough. Positive is north of the equator.
settings.loadDemoHelp: This replaces everything with the example plot. Back up first if you want to keep your own plan.
settings.notPersisted: The browser may clear your data if space runs low.
settings.persist: Ask the browser to keep data
settings.persisted: The browser has agreed to keep your data.
settings.placeHint: Shown on the plan; stays on this device
settings.plotNameHint: For example, Plot 14 or Back garden
settings.privacy: No tracking, no cookies, no adverts. Nothing leaves this device unless you export it.
settings.rangeAuto: From now to the end of the plan
settings.restoreError.format: That file isn't a plot planner backup.
settings.restoreError.json: That file isn't a backup: it can't be read as JSON.
settings.restoreError.newer: That backup is from a newer version of the app. Reload the page to update, then try again.
settings.rotationHelp: You get a warning if a crop family comes back to the same ground sooner.
settings.rotationYears: Years between the same crop family
settings.sharingHelp: Share a plan as a file or link, or open one someone sent you. Shared plans arrive as drafts.
settings.sizeHelp: Width runs across the plan, length runs down it. You can change both later.
settings.top: At the top of the plan
settings.topHelp: Draw the plot the way you picture it. Compass labels follow.
share.contents: {plantings} plantings and {tasks} of your own tasks. Seed records and notes are not included.
share.fileHelp: Works for any size of plan. Send it by email or message; they open it from Settings.
share.intro: Send your plan to someone else. They open it in their own copy of the planner, where it arrives as drafts and changes nothing of theirs until they accept it.
share.linkHelp: Read-only. The whole plan is inside the link ({n} characters), so nothing is stored on a server.
share.locationHelp: Left unticked, the town and coordinates are removed. Frost dates are always included, because the plan depends on them.
share.title: Share this plan
share.tooLong: This plan makes a link of {n} characters, too long to send reliably (the limit is {max}). Share it as a file instead, or share one plot.
shareIn.addedGarden: Added a garden with {n} draft plantings
shareIn.asGardenHelp: Adds their whole layout as a new garden you can switch to. Its plantings are drafts.
shareIn.fromHint: Optional, for example Sam or the allotment committee
shareIn.intoPlot: As drafts in one of my plots
shareIn.intoPlotHelp: Plantings go into areas with the same names as theirs.
shareIn.matched: {n} of {of} plantings have a matching area name here.
shareIn.safe: Everything arrives as drafts. Your own plan and tasks stay exactly as they are until you accept drafts.
shareIn.title: Add a shared plan
shared.error.bad: This link or file doesn't contain a plan. It may have been cut short when it was copied. Ask for the plan as a file instead.
shared.error.newer: This plan was made with a newer version of the planner. Reload the page to update, then open it again.
shared.readOnly: Read-only: nothing is saved unless you add it.
shared.title: Shared plan
summary.elsewhere.other: {n} jobs at home or in the propagator
summary.quiet: a quiet month on the plot
tasks.empty.next: Nothing due in the next two weeks.
tasks.icsHelp: Add to calendar saves a file your calendar app can import, so you get reminders without an account. Save it again after big changes.
tasks.icsSaved: Saved a calendar file with {n} tasks
te.title: What to do
toast.climateChanged: Frost dates changed. Dates moved to match.
toast.protectionChanged: Protection changed. Tender crops moved to match.
warn.conflict: {a} and {b} overlap in the same ground from {from}.
warn.conflict.now: {a} and {b} overlap in the same ground.
warn.crossing: {a} and {b} ({species}) can cross and will flower together, {distance} m apart. They need {isolation} m.
warn.crossing.apart: {a} and {b} ({species}) can cross and will flower together. They need {isolation} m apart.
warn.crossing.options: Grow them further apart, stagger the sowings so they flower at different times, or hand-pollinate and bag the flowers.
warn.endDate: {name} runs until {until}, after the plot ends on {end}.
warn.frost: {name} goes out on {date}, before the last frost (about {lastFrost}). Plant later, or protect it.
warn.frostFree: {name} needs about {needed} frost-free days; this spot gets about {has}.
warn.missingArea: {name} is in an area that no longer exists. Move it to another area.
warn.oldSeed: {name} seed is from {acquired}; it usually keeps about {years} years. Do a germination test.
warn.outgrow: {name} spends {days} days in modules; most plants outgrow their cells after {max}. Pot on or sow later.
warn.problem: {problem} was logged here on {date}, and {name} is prone to it.
warn.propCapacity: {space} needs {needed} {unit} in the week of {week} but holds {capacity}.
warn.rotation: {name} is {group}, which grew here in {when}. Leave {years} years between them if you can.
